# 24Seven Limousine - Sales & Fleet Intelligence Platform

> 24Seven Limousine is Egypt's leading luxury transportation, airport transfer, corporate mobility, and automotive investment management company.

## Overview
- **Website:** https://24seven-ai.com
- **Headquarters:** Cairo & Alexandria, Egypt
- **Operating Regions:** Cairo, Alexandria, Hurghada, Sharm El-Sheikh, Ain Sokhna, El Gouna, North Coast, Marsa Matruh.
- **Operating Hours:** 24/7/365
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +201121748885
- **Email:** info@24seven-ai.com

## Core Services

### 1. Luxury Airport Transfers & Tourism (نقل المطار والسياحة)
- **Coverage:** Cairo International Airport (CAI), Borg El Arab Airport (HBE), Sharm El Sheikh Airport (SSH), Hurghada Airport (HRG).
- **Fleet:** 2025 Luxury Sedans (Mercedes E-Class, Toyota Corolla, Hyundai Elantra), Family SUVs, and Tourist HiAce Vans.
- **Features:** Meet & Greet inside terminal, luggage handling, flight monitoring, toll/parking fee included.
- **Booking URL:** https://24seven-ai.com/limousine.html

### 2. Corporate Mobility & Conference Logistics (خدمات الشركات والمؤتمرات)
- Dedicated executive chauffeuring, daily/monthly business transport, tax-compliant invoicing, official billing accounts.
- Corporate booking portal: https://24seven-ai.com/limousine.html

### 3. Vehicle Investment Program (استثمار وتشغيل السيارات)
- **Program:** Private car owners can onboard vehicles (2020+ models) into the corporate fleet for guaranteed monthly payouts.
- **Guarantees:** Legally binding contract, comprehensive insurance handling, certified maintenance & wear coverage, 24/7 live GPS telematics.
- **Details & Return Calculator:** https://24seven-ai.com/invest.html

### 4. Weddings & Special VIP Events (الزفاف والمناسبات)
- Premium and classic wedding car packages with decorated chauffeurs.
- Details: https://24seven-ai.com/home.html
